archive_framework_sections: The 2021 Eq. 24, 26 give CKM/PMNS phases and scalar projectors. Eq. 58 belongs to a different simplified texture; do not present those phases as the present prediction.
interpretation: Rank-one left row of a real-Yukawa two-Higgs model. Three light Dirac neutrinos and unitary propagation in the published experimental templates; nonstandard charged scalar or matter effects must be matched. Modern JUNO and earlier T2K disappearance/Daya Bay are used as CP-even calibration; external constraints overlap the joint fit. No multiplication of credible intervals or reuse of fitted leptonic delta.
